channel.title: The Fox News Rundown
channel.description: The FOX News Rundown is your daily news podcast for making sense of the big issues directly impacting your life. Go beyond the headlines every morning and join some of FOX News’ most exceptional journalists—including FOX News Channel reporters Peter Doocy, Aishah Hasnie, Bill Melugin, Alex Hogan, Lucas Tomlinson and Jacqui Heinrich and FOX News Radio reporters Dave Anthony, Jessica Rosenthal, Lisa Brady, and Gurnal Scott - as they tap into the global reporting resources of FOX News and get unparalleled political analysis and exclusive insight from top newsmakers. The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: Hugh Hewitt on Midterm Showdowns, Volatile Polls, and 2028 Predictions
item.description:
With the midterms in the final stretch, radio host and political analyst Hugh Hewitt joins Jessica Rosenthal on The FOX News Rundown: Extra to break down the electorate. Hewitt discusses why voters should look past volatile polling data, where campaign money and high-profile surrogates are actually moving, and how key legislative battles over the economy, Medicaid, and the "Working Families Tax Cut" are shaping the final days of the campaign.
Plus, Hewitt shares his bold predictions for Congress's future, potential 2028 presidential contenders on both sides of the aisle, and the ongoing geopolitical showdown with Iran. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: The House Races That Will Matter The Most Tuesday
item.description:
With forecasts pointing toward Democrats potentially flipping the House, questions remain over how wide their prospective margin might be and what that means for control of Capitol Hill. Fox News Senior Congressional Correspondent Chad Pergram joins to dissect pivotal battlegrounds from Pennsylvania to Ohio, the impact of Hispanic turnout in Texas and California, and how majority margins will test both Hakeem Jeffries’ caucus control and President Trump’s hold on the GOP.Plus, New Jersey Congressman Tom Kean Jr. makes his reelection case, highlighting affordability, taxes, and Iran while addressing questions about missed votes, health, and stock trading.

item.title: Jillian Michaels on 'Toxic' Culture & The "Catastrophic" Crisis Facing Our Kids
item.description:
Health expert and fitness icon Jillian Michaels joins Lisa Brady on The FOX News Rundown: Extra to unpack her timely FOX Nation special, Toxic: A Generation on the Brink. Michaels dives deep into the unprecedented pressures facing Gen Z and Gen Alpha today, from toxic social media algorithms and the "pornification" of youth to the dark realities of online drug markets and over-medication.
Plus, Michaels shares actionable, common-sense steps parents can take right now to set boundaries, protect their kids' mental and physical well-being, and navigate a digital landscape driven by corporate greed.

item.itunes:author: FOX News Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
In the final days before midterm voting wraps up, Republicans are making the final push to maintain a slim majority - and flip any seats they can.  Republican Congressman and U.S. Senate Candidate Mike Collins joins The Rundown to discuss his bid to unseat Democratic incumbent Jon Ossoff (D-GA), highlight his legislative record, and remind voters what is at stake should Democrats regain a congressional majority.


Later, Montana Independent Senate candidate Seth Bodnar breaks down his three-way race, addressing his push for rural healthcare reform, the need for Congress to reassert war powers amid conflict with Iran, and why running as an independent is starting to look like a viable campaign strategy.

item.title: Battleground Iowa: Economic Strain and High Diesel Prices Loom Over Iowa’s Competitive Midterm Races
item.description:
In this special battleground state edition of The FOX News Rundown: Evening Edition, FOX's Jacqui Heinrich takes a look at the tight congressional and gubernatorial races in the state.
Nominees in Iowa’s toss-up Senate race are sparring over high prices and transgender issues. Rep. Ashley Hinson (R-IA) campaigned with President Trump, who won Iowa by double digits, but is distancing herself from him on issues like Iran. State Rep. Josh Turek seeks to become Iowa’s first elected Democratic senator since 2008. He’ll visit a farm today to highlight how high costs are challenging the state’s critical agriculture industry.
Megan Goldberg, Assistant Professor of American politics at Cornell College, who says the normally very 'red state' has changed over the past few years.

item.title: Decoys, Legal Fights And The Final Nasty Days Before The Midterms
item.description:
A bombshell report in Alaska is shaking up the final days before the midterm elections. Following allegations that a candidate named Daniel J. Sullivan was placed on the ballot to potentially siphon votes and confuse voters in the race against Democratic Senate Candidate Mary Peltola, investigations into the matter are underway. "FOX News Sunday" Anchor and host of the Livin' the Bream Podcast Shannon Bream joins the Rundown to break down the legal and political fallout of the alleged scheme and what it means for the race just days away from election day.
With just days until the election, the battle for Congress boils down to one question: Are voters feeling the headline growth, or the squeeze at the checkout counter? FOX Business Contributor, co-host of Big Money in the Morning, and editor of the Barron’s Investor’s Circle newsletter Josh Schafer discusses the mixed economic data, like strong GDP and steady jobs—the reality of grocery and gas prices rising faster than wages, and how the massive AI tech buildout is driving Wall Street momentum.
PLUS, commentary by FOX News contributor Joe Concha.
PHOTO CREDIT: AP IMAGES
